rows.title: Malformed tool-call entries are silently discarded
rows.impact: filter_map returns None if tool_id is absent; no malformed-call receipt is emitted per dropped entry.
rows.break_test: Send a tool_calls array with one valid call and one malformed dangerous call; ensure the malformed one appears in receipts.

rows.title: Tool-result serialization failure silently becomes an empty message
rows.impact: serde_json::to_string(&request.tool_results).unwrap_or_default() can erase tool evidence in the provider prompt.
rows.break_test: Inject a non-serializable or serialization-failing tool result type via test double and assert the request does not silently drop it.
rows.recommended_fix: Return a provider request construction error with an execution receipt; never substitute empty content.
rows.acceptance_evidence_required: code diff + targeted regression test + p30_guard pass + phase report receipt

rows.phase_title: Executable tool-call parser boundary and strict structured-output law
rows.title: Successful parser repair drops degradation reason codes from returned result

rows.recommended_fix: Propagate parser-fallback and boundary-repair reason codes into turn reports and downstream receipts.

rows.phase_title: Executable tool-call parser boundary and strict structured-output law
rows.title: Parser fallback uses permissive degraded JSON repair in the tool-call path

rows.title: Patch apply treats unreadable/missing files as empty input

rows.break_test: Try patching a missing file with replacement expecting empty input; observe whether it creates unintended new content.
rows.recommended_fix: Fail closed on read errors; distinguish create-file operation from replace-in-existing-file operation.
